title: NOW
text:
i had no idea what i was getting into
the enticing cover of night
no photos
joys, sorrows fresh
off the bus
the ship
my jailbreak, my destiny
now
control is a fickle thing
while running away
suitcase in hand determined towards the sun

title: Comedown
text:
walking back from basement, stunned
a giant bird on the sidewalk
shot dead on a quiet morning
